claims.text: Verification is externally enforced: author-controlled execution may contribute evidence, but conformance requires a verifier operating under a separately recorded authority.
claims.rhetorical_role: state the central proposed protocol constraint
claims.evidence: prospective-lifecycle-v0.2-draft.md defines the requirement but lists independent exercise and formal schemas as unresolved
claims.caveat: The current repository does not demonstrate external enforcement.
claims.unresolved_question: What exact external controller, authority boundary, and exercised transition record instantiate this requirement?

claims.text: The current implementation has passed schema, replay, and adversarial fixture checks.
claims.evidence: Only author-reported aggregate counts appear in the manuscript; no itemized repository evidence map exists.
claims.caveat: The body discloses the author-reported status but the abstract does not.
claims.unresolved_question: Where are the exact implementation revision, fixtures, commands, logs, and digests?

claims.text: The residual MCRP proposal is narrower: a prospective, externally enforced, claim-versioned lifecycle.
claims.rhetorical_role: define the residual contribution after prior-art subtraction
claims.evidence: The closest-work matrix identifies this as a conditional residual gap, not established novelty.
claims.caveat: A residual gap becomes a contribution only if the semantic delta is implemented and shown useful.
claims.unresolved_question: Can the residual semantics be expressed by EVI/PROV plus policy, and do they improve any measured outcome?

claims.text: MCRP should be implemented as a profile over existing standards where possible.
claims.evidence: The novelty matrix shows that reinvention would overlap established standards and identifies profiles and round-trip tests as required evidence.
claims.citation: PROV-O, RO-Crate, Workflow Run RO-Crate, Zenodo versioning
claims.caveat: The recommendation does not establish current interoperability.
claims.unresolved_question: Which normative mappings and loss boundaries will the first profile implement?

claims.text: Only empirical work could establish whether MCRP is usable or improves review outcomes.
claims.rhetorical_role: bound the conclusion and define the promotion gate
claims.evidence: The novelty ledger and evaluation agenda explicitly leave comparative benefit unanswered.
claims.caveat: The study must include simpler baselines, independent adjudication, burden, and adverse outcomes.
